title: Refusal
description: The body of a refusal the control plane answers an adapter's request with, application/json. The codes an adapter meets: 401 unauthorized, unsigned and the same whatever the cause: an unknown or revoked access key, a key of another kind, a bad signature, a GET's X-Qory-Timestamp or a POST's time more than 300 seconds from the control plane's clock, either way, or a request whose signature it has already seen, under the replay rule of definitions.schema.json; 403 forbidden, a request outside the access key's rights; 400 unsupported_contract_version, an X-Qory-Contract-Version the control plane does not serve; 400 invalid_request, a body that breaks its schema; 413, a request over 1 MiB; 409 collection_not_linked, items of a collection that is not linked to a workspace; 429 rate_limited, with Retry-After, the seconds the adapter waits before it sends the request again, built anew, as definitions.schema.json describes a retry. A 401 is unsigned; every answer to a verified request is signed, as definitions.schema.json describes. A member this schema does not define is refused.
